visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A fair-skinned woman with a high ponytail, dressed in a light tan knit sweater, stands behind a white suitcase and next to a black one. She gestures broadly with her hands, pointing to the luggage while maintaining an expressive, smiling facial expression. The scene is a well-lit indoor room with a leafy green plant in the background and a simple white door. (2) The camera moves closer to focus on the black suitcase as the woman's hands unzip the front panel. She reveals a light green interior lining with a padded laptop compartment and several mesh storage pockets. She demonstrates the functionality by sliding a thin grey laptop into the sleeve and smoothing the fabric with her fingers. (3) The scene transitions to the larger white suitcase, which is positioned vertically. The front cover is partially opened to show a deep, spacious main compartment, which the woman describes as fridge-style. She reaches inside to show the depth and the internal straps, while her facial expressions remain animated and communicative toward the viewer. (4) Detailed insert shots highlight the silver TSA-approved combination lock, a dual USB charging port with a protective rubber cover, and a sliding mechanical brake button on the side of the shell. The woman's hands are seen pressing the buttons and flipping the covers to demonstrate their smooth operation and tactile quality. (5) Both suitcases are laid flat on the floor, opened from the top rather than split in the middle. The woman kneels beside them, showing how little floor space they occupy compared to traditional designs. The lighting remains bright and even, highlighting the textured vertical lines on the plastic shells of the luggage.
